title: Bix's classical listening at the hotel suite
summary: Bix visited Challis's hotel suite to listen to Debussy and other impressionist works.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Was he music a lot of the time, you know, on and off the stand? Was he very much into his music as it has been written?

Oh, yeah, fine appreciation for music. Fine. Of course, I have sat with him at nights, nothing else would do, we would go over -- I had a suite in the hotel there and he had a little joint over in a place called the Billinghurst. They used to call them flea bags, and a lot of the musicians stayed there, but how long are musicians in their rooms? Very seldom.

But anyway I had a place, because I had to have a place to work, so we'd come over there and I think his favorite that he liked to listen to a lot was Afternoon of a Faun. We used to listen to that a lot and then the Firebird, of course, "La Mer." and Mamore. All the Debussy and --
